newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: EARLY WALL ST HOIST S.AFRICAN INDUSTRIALS AT CLOSE.
newsitem.headline: EARLY WALL ST HOIST S.AFRICAN INDUSTRIALS AT CLOSE.

text.p: South African industrials finish slightly firmer on the back of Wall Street's stronger opening, after weaker earlier start.

Dealers say golds steady but unconvincing on sickly bullion price at around $340 an ounce and poor gold quarterly results which, however, mostly discounted. Volumes moderate with around 685 million rand worth of shares traded.
Sentiment good. Dealers see Friday's trade sideways to slightly better after some further consolidation.
Profit-taking seen hitting select financial stocks.
* Features on the day include Richemont which sheds 50 cents to 64.50 rand and M-Cell which loses 30 cents to 522 cents after over five million shares trade in bookover.
* Industrials end up preliminary 10.6 points to 8,425.4, golds down 1.3 points to 1,230.5 and all-share 7.7 points up to 7,087.9.
